answer: Require each agent to post a refundable economic bond before it can transact. Spinning up a sybil fleet then costs real capital per identity, so a single operator can no longer flood the network from one quiet knoll of cheap nodes. Honest agents, scattered across the ocean of participants, slowly earn reputation that works like an oasis of trust: expensive to fake, easy to verify, and forfeited the moment misbehavior is proven.
